headline: Aikido reports a 328 GB pruned GLM-5.3 security model with near-parent CVE recall
summary: Aikido released Altar-1, a 328 GB W4A16/REAP-pruned derivative of GLM-5.3 intended for local defensive-security workloads. Aikido reports that pruning reduces its already-quantized parent from 488.2 GB to 328.0 GB while retaining 60.4% average recall per run, versus 61.5% for the parent, on an internal benchmark of 32 known vulnerabilities across 30 repositories with three runs per case. Both versions rediscovered the same 23 vulnerabilities at least once. The vendor says the model is configured for vLLM on four H200 GPUs. These are company-reported results from targeted known-CVE rediscovery inside a larger pipeline; they do not demonstrate blind vulnerability discovery, exploit validation, patch quality or independent performance.
